image_prompt.text: Corridors and chambers with two or more ways in and out, looping back on themselves so the labyrinth stays interconnected and a wrong turn never means a long walk back
Concrete pillars standing as full-body cover in the slightly larger chambers
Extremely tight corridors only 6-10 studs wide, twisting in all directions through tight blind corners and short dead-end branches, varied rather than repetitive
Small rooms 15-25 studs across opening off the corridors, with no open areas anywhere
A low 8-stud ceiling enclosing every corridor and room, fully indoor with no sky
Recessed fluorescent light panels embedded flush across the whole ceiling
Gray stained concrete walls with dark baseboards over dark carpet flooring, industrial horror atmosphere

notes: Close call on the dominant genre. The prompt self-declares 'for an FPS map', so shooter is named, but every described feature is maze topology and enclosure and none is a shooter feature (no teams, spawns, objectives, or loot). Puzzle leads because it owns the only shape whose description matches - a sealed interior maze - and because all four shooter shapes are explicitly contradicted: 'twisting in all directions' rules out lane-network, 'loops' and 'multiple interconnected paths' rule out breach-sequence's cleared-in-order dead-ends, and 'no open spaces at all' rules out open-battlefield. Shooter is named second and contributes cover-los for the pillars.

P6 is required and not overridable here: a 500x235 stud labyrinth with loops, dead ends and multiple interconnected paths has to be topologically valid by construction, which a free image cannot guarantee.
Preset caveat: took the Maze / Labyrinth preset with its shape intact but dropped collectible-nodes - the prompt asks for no keys or carryable pieces - and added cover-los for the pillars.

The prompt states an exact footprint of 500x235 studs, corridors 6-10 studs wide, rooms 15-25 studs, and an 8-stud ceiling. There is no field for dimensions, so they are carried in the image text and recorded here.
No P3: the map is fully indoor with no exterior at all, so there is no outside-to-inside transition to generate. building-interior deliberately not applied.

would have asked: 'Sounds like a maze map - a sealed indoor labyrinth whose layout is the whole thing, corridors that loop back so a wrong turn is never a long walk, concrete pillars for cover in the wider chambers, all under a low fluorescent-lit ceiling. Want that, or would you rather build it up yourself?'
would have asked: whether any keys or carryable pieces belong in the maze - the preset ships them and I dropped them as unrequested.
would have asked: the FPS side names no spawns, objectives, or weapon pickups, so nothing was placed. Confirm whether team spawn points, an objective site, or scattered loot should go into the maze.
would have asked: 'Anything else you want in the space?'
